name: QA agent
summary: Tests a deployed ticket against its contract in a browser, expected results first, with API assertions; posts a QA card with evidence and flake notes and sends failures back to the engineer with an exact repro.

maxRounds.label: Failed QA rounds before asking you

captureNetwork.label: Capture API requests and responses for every case

screenshotEachCase.label: Save a screenshot at each case's verdict and at failures (checkpoints only)
